cset.interpretation: Latest available year per input or stage. Reported geography shares, not outage probabilities or capacities.
cset.caveat: Repository main/data snapshot; its README distinguishes it from the official release. Various countries and EUR are aggregate geographies, not single countries. Shares can be missing, rounded, or sum above 100. No normalization or cross-year summing.

smat.interpretation: Static AMHS/factory topology inventory, not observed production or delay labels.
smat.caveat: No throughput, yield, utilization, capacity, or delay forecast is inferred from equipment counts. The repository simulator is Windows-only and is not executed.

relationship: Three separate datasets; no validated record-level join exists between them.
